title: GhostClaw Route Matrix
description: Validates the route matrix YAML that defines task routing, agent assignments, and tier access within the SIRINX OS GhostClaw system.

routes.description: Map of task types to responsible agents, reviewers, architects, and validators.

task_type.description: Category of work this route handles.

primary_agent.description: Agent ID responsible for executing this task type.

reviewer_agent.description: Agent ID responsible for reviewing output of this task type.

architect_agent.description: Agent ID responsible for architectural oversight of this task type.

validator_agent.description: Agent ID responsible for formal validation of this task type.

smoke_test_agent.description: Agent ID responsible for smoke testing output of this task type.

tier.description: Sensitivity or access tier required for this route.

constraints.description: Operational constraints or conditions that apply to this route.

projects.description: Project IDs that this route applies to. Empty means global applicability.
